title: WS9 live-arm 2 (addendum 2) — TAG-FLIP e2e: the .75 401 tags-config class through the real harness send path (apex-ayl.78, ship gate; .75 = 61dec18 R8 AFFINITY-POLICY-1). Seat gpt-5.6-sol (responses wire). Premise (proxy-capability-matrix.md §2/§3-D): the operator's live config already carries x-litellm-tags: 'East US 2' on the sol row (extra_headers, wire-intact at PG-3 verify) — a session whose history carries foreign-boundary (non-EU2-origin) sol markers meeting that tag is the documented .75 exposure path ('tagless->tagged config change / tag edit mid-campaign', matrix §3 reading 5). Mechanism: the hermetic home copies the live config (tag inherited — NEVER the operator's ~/.grok/config.toml, launcher-side only); config_patch sets model/gpt-5.6-sol/strict_responses_input=false so the row rides the lenient verbatim path (the harness's unconditional strip_encrypted_content_input still strips the FIELD; the encitem_ ID rides — provider.rs:192-211 + project_strict_responses_input no-op when strict=false; lenient KEEP ruling 2026-09-14). The session is cell-seeded (xwfix seed path, absolute cell dir /tmp/ws9-run/arm-tagflip-cell) with a CAPTURED live marker (ws9-arm-probe arm_seed.json: non-EU2-origin encitem id + encrypted_content; the switch_model step is a same-model no-op that scores the storage-diff against expected.json at seed time). Verdict semantics (.75 contract): PASS = the marker rides the first request (anti-vacuous) AND the gateway rejects it with the tags-config 401 ('Not allowed to access model due to tags', 1s pre-affinity) AND the .75 classifier arm classifies + strips + retries ONCE (markerless) AND the retry is served 200 by the tagged EU2 pool AND the turn completes (done pin) AND no storm (2-4 requests). FAIL (S3 report-and-stop) = the 401 is unrecovered (terminal error) or a retry storm (>4). VACUOUS (mechanism, recorded) = the marker never rode (anti-vacuous 0-hit: the premise did not engage — e.g. the lenient patch did not take or the seed did not replay). Severity if the 401 class surfaces: S1 self-healing (contracted strip of the model-bound marker touches persisted history = +1-tier S2 candidate ON REVIEW — the strip is the .75/.58 fix behavior under test, not an incidental leak; the user-visible outcome is intact).

steps.note: SEED (xwfix path): the captured non-EU2-origin sol marker history; same-model switch = no-op wall-wise, scores the storage-diff at seed time (expected.json = the seed verbatim).

TAG-FLIP OBSERVED-STATE RECORD: the EU2 tag rides from the operator's live config (extra_headers on the sol row — inherited into the hermetic copy; the config_patch above touches ONLY strict_responses_input, never the tag). Expected wire sequence: req-001 carries the encitem_ id (marker; the FIELD is stripped by the unconditional strip_encrypted_content_input — the id is the surviving marker) + x-litellm-tags: East US 2 -> gateway 401 tags-config (1s, pre-affinity; the .75 classifier's message key) -> .75 arm: classify as model-bound-history -> strip via the .58 machinery -> retry-once (request_task.rs:466 contract shape) -> req-002 markerless -> 200 (tagged EU2 single-deployment pool, matrix §3-A constancy) -> turn completes. The 401 arm itself is unit-validated at .75 with the incident's verbatim body; this row is the LIVE e2e validation of the full classify->strip->retry->recovery path through the real send path. Structural note recorded: strict sol rows are marker-free (id+content projected; field unconditionally stripped) and are therefore structurally immune to the tags class — the exposure is the lenient/cross-model marker path this row reproduces.

ndjson.label: RECOVERY: the turn completed with the exact terminal text after the 401->strip->retry cycle (no unrecovered 401, .75 contract).
NO TERMINAL ERROR: the 401 was recovered in-flight (headless: the turn process would surface an error event if the retry terminated unrecovered).

wire.label: ANTI-VACUOUS (premise pin): the first sol request carries the seeded encitem_ marker id (lenient verbatim ride; 0-hit = the premise never engaged = VACUOUS mechanism finding, never a silent pass).
TAGS-CONFIG 401: the marker-carrying request is rejected at the gateway (matrix §2: tag set of the pinned origin excludes the request tag; 1s pre-affinity fail-fast).

wire.grep: Not allowed to access model due to tags
wire.label: 401 BODY VERBATIM CLASS (recon record — resp captures are JSONL and cannot carry a G10 where, house discipline): the .75 classifier's message key as recorded from the captured response. The SCORED class surface is the first_401 resp_status pin (401 on the marker-carrying request); the body phrasing is recorded for adjudication — a 401 body that does NOT carry this key = an adjacent error class = escalate (record + coordinator ruling).
RECOVERY 200: the final sol request (the post-strip retry, markerless) is served 200 by the tagged EU2 pool — the .75 contract's no-unrecovered-401 face.
NO-RETRY-STORM: 2 = the clean 401->strip->retry shape; 3-4 = tolerated side calls; >4 = storm (auto S3 per ws9-12row-schema §2).
